content.title: Fiction Dismantled | Anchored Pullback to Set and Monitor Layers
content.summary: Earn belief through one coherent fictional performance, begin a continuous retreat around a stable prop and action anchor, cross the set boundary with at least three production cues, reveal the original fiction inside a monitoring layer and end with one compact perception question.

quick_start.input_format: credible fictional scene and adult performer + one practical prop or light anchor + continuous retreat preserving the performer action + at least three production cues + original image inside a monitoring layer + one short original judgment card
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult astronaut raises one glove toward a cyan navigation disc in an icy chamber; a continuous retreat reveals a miniature ice set, snow fans, a motion-control rail and crew, then two monitors repeat the original close-up before the text 'REAL ENOUGH?'.
required_anchors: Earn belief through one coherent fictional scene and emotionally legible performer before exposing construction.
Use one practical prop or light and one performer action as continuous registration anchors during the retreat.
Show the original fictional image inside a monitoring or capture layer after the physical set reveal.
Finish with one compact audience-facing judgment prompt and no new exposition.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Earn belief through one coherent fictional performance, begin a continuous retreat around a stable prop and action anchor, cross the set boundary with at least three production cues, reveal the original fiction inside a monitoring layer and end with one compact perception question.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Build one self-contained fictional scene with a stable performer, emotionally legible objective and a practical light or prop anchor. Hold the fiction long enough to earn belief, then let the performer make one small physical approach toward that anchor while the camera begins one continuous retreat. Preserve performer, prop and action as registration anchors while the frame crosses the set boundary and reveals at least three production cues. Continue to a monitoring layer that visibly contains the original fiction, then end with one short audience-facing perception question. The reusable mechanism is belief, anchored retreat, physical production reveal, mediated recursion and judgment—not the source historical drama, Chinese corridor, green costume, lantern, actress, green screen arrangement, monitors, exact wording, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Earn belief through one coherent fictional scene and emotionally legible performer before exposing construction.
invariants.purpose: Makes the later reveal reclassify real prior evidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate backstage view removes surprise and emotional investment.

invariants.rule: Use one practical prop or light and one performer action as continuous registration anchors during the retreat.
invariants.purpose: Proves that the fiction and production space are the same event.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated cut can be dismissed as a different location.

invariants.rule: Reveal at least three distinct production cues beyond the set boundary.
invariants.purpose: Turns a vague pullback into falsifiable making-of evidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: One stray light stand is too ambiguous to reclassify the world.

invariants.rule: Show the original fictional image inside a monitoring or capture layer after the physical set reveal.
invariants.purpose: Adds a second level of mediation and verifies the constructed frame.
invariants.ablation_failure: Stopping at the set edge loses the recursive proof.

invariants.rule: Finish with one compact audience-facing judgment prompt and no new exposition.
invariants.purpose: Transfers the viewer from story consumption to perception audit.
invariants.ablation_failure: A long explanation dilutes the reveal and dictates the conclusion.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman's identity, facial performance, hair, green historical costume and exact emotional beats
the source Chinese palace corridor, red columns, paving, hanging lantern and architecture
the source green backing, lights, crew, floor equipment, monitor arrangement and exact reveal path
the source end-card phrase, timing, aspect, color treatment, shot rhythm and creator framing
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 claim, watermark, platform overlay and branding
